## SnapSense 0.1.5

- Added a visible Linux launcher with a Capture region button for desktops such as GNOME that do not show tray icons.
- Added a `--capture` command that forwards to an existing SnapSense process, so GNOME Wayland can bind a custom keyboard shortcut to it.
- Changed the Linux X11 shortcut to Ctrl + Alt + S, avoiding GNOME's Super + Alt + S screen-reader shortcut.
- The launcher shows the exact command to copy into GNOME Keyboard settings and reappears after a cancelled capture or closed result panel.
